verdict.rationale: The only evidence pointing at ticket-to-agent assignment is a single community comment implying a paid Linear integration ('No linear integration in free version'), with no first-party docs describing how an issue/ticket triggers a workspace or agent task. Other cited flows (PR diff feedback, Design element selection) start from code artifacts, not tickets. missing for 10: first-party documentation of a Linear/Jira/GitHub-Issues 'assign to agent' flow, screenshots or API endpoints showing ticket import, and independent confirmation the integration works end-to-end.
